page.notes: The first word "nam" is a sentence fragment carried over from the previous page, so it is left as a fragment. Long s is read as plain s throughout, so the printed "fano", "fpem", "fpeciminum" and "ifthæc" appear here as "sano", "spem", "speciminum" and "isthæc".
